column2: The shop owner tried to woo customers with free samples and a friendly smile.
column3: 店老闆試著用免費試用品和親切的笑容來爭取顧客。
column5: woo 像「無」：無論如何都要追到手

column2: He wrenched the stuck door open with both hands.
column3: 他用雙手把卡住的門猛力扭開。
column4: wrench the door open (猛力扭開門)
column5: wrench 也是扳手，扳手一轉就是猛扭；w 不發音

column2: The two brothers wrestled on the grass until their mother called them in.
column3: 兩兄弟在草地上扭打，直到媽媽叫他們進屋。
column4: wrestle with a problem (與難題搏鬥)
column5: wrestle 像「瑞索」，兩人互相纏鬥；w 不發音

column2: Please xerox these pages for every student before class starts.
column3: 請在上課前把這幾頁影印給每位學生。
column5: Xerox 原是影印機品牌，念「吉洛克斯」，後來變成動詞「影印」

column2: After a year abroad, he yearned for his mother's cooking.
column3: 在國外待了一年後，他好想念媽媽煮的菜。
column5: year 一年 + n：一年又一年地想念

column2: The ship stopped, and a small boat pulled up alongside.
column3: 船停了下來，一艘小艇靠到了船邊。
column5: along 沿著 + side 邊 → 沿著邊，在旁邊

column2: Hereafter, all students must show their cards at the library door.
column3: 從此以後，所有學生都必須在圖書館門口出示證件。
column5: here 這裡 + after 之後 → 從現在起

column2: She won the contest in May, and thereafter she received invitations every week.
column3: 她五月贏得比賽，之後每週都收到邀請。
column5: there 那時 + after 之後 → 從那之後

column2: He saved ten dollars a week, thereby paying off his debt in a year.
column3: 他每週存十元，因此一年就還清了債務。
column4: thereby reducing costs (從而降低成本)
column5: there 那件事 + by 藉由 → 藉著它，因此

column2: Aborigines have lived in Australia for tens of thousands of years.
column3: 原住民在澳洲已經生活了數萬年。
column5: ab 從 + origin 起源 → 從最初就住在那裡的人

column2: Love and justice are abstractions that cannot be seen or touched.
column3: 愛與正義是看不見也摸不到的抽象概念。
column4: think in abstractions (以抽象概念思考)
column5: abs 拉開 + tract 拉 → 從具體事物拉出來 → 抽象

column2: The building was repaired in accordance with the new safety rules.
column3: 這棟建築依照新的安全規定進行了修繕。
column5: ac 向 + cord 心 → 心向規則一致 → 符合

column2: My sister studies accounting because she likes working with numbers.
column3: 我姊姊念會計，因為她喜歡跟數字打交道。
column5: account 帳目 + ing → 管帳的學問，會計

column2: Nobody believed the accusation that the quiet boy had cheated on the test.
column3: 沒有人相信那個安靜男孩作弊的指控。
column5: accuse 指控的名詞，指著人說「就是你」

column2: A young activist collected signatures to save the old park.
column3: 一位年輕的行動者蒐集連署來保住那座老公園。
column5: active 行動 + ist 人 → 積極採取行動的人

column2: His addiction to video games made it hard for him to sleep.
column3: 他對電玩上癮，讓他很難入睡。
column5: 阿弟玩遊戲停不下來，就是 addiction 上癮

column2: The school administration decided to move the sports day to Friday.
column3: 學校行政單位決定把運動會改到星期五。
column5: administer 管理 + ation；行政處就是 administration

column2: The hospital administrator signed the new schedule for all nurses.
column3: 醫院的行政主管簽署了全體護理師的新班表。
column5: administer 管理 + or 人 → 管理的人

column2: The dog's aggression frightened the children walking past the gate.
column3: 那隻狗的攻擊性嚇到了走過大門的孩子們。
column5: ag 朝向 + gress 走 → 朝別人衝過去 → 侵犯

column2: The two countries formed an alliance to protect their trade routes.
column3: 兩國結成聯盟，以保護彼此的貿易路線。
column5: ally 盟友 + ance；盟友湊在一起就是聯盟

column2: The ambiguity of the sign left drivers unsure which way to turn.
column3: 標誌意思不清，讓駕駛人不確定該往哪邊轉。
column5: ambi 兩邊 → 話可以往兩邊解釋，意思不明

column2: Students in Taiwan often read the Analects of Confucius in Chinese class.
column3: 台灣學生常在國文課讀孔子的《論語》。
column4: the Analects of Confucius (孔子的論語)
column5: analects 就是《論語》：一段段挑出來的語錄文選

column2: A market analyst studied the sales data and explained why profits had dropped.
column3: 一位市場分析師研究銷售數據，說明獲利為何下滑。
column5: analyze 分析 + ist 人 → 分析師

column2: The anchorman thanked viewers and read the final news story of the night.
column3: 男主播謝謝觀眾，並播報了當晚的最後一則新聞。
column4: evening news anchorman (晚間新聞男主播)
column5: anchor 船錨穩住船，anchorman 穩坐新聞台的男主播

column2: The anchorwoman smiled at the camera before announcing the weather report.
column3: 女主播對著鏡頭微笑，然後播報天氣預報。
column5: anchor 定錨 + woman：節目的定錨，女主播

column2: The constant noise from the street was a daily annoyance for the neighbors.
column3: 街上不斷的噪音是鄰居們每天的困擾。
column5: annoy 惹惱 + ance；蚊子嗡嗡叫就是 annoyance

column2: Dad moved the antenna on the roof to get a clearer TV picture.
column3: 爸爸移動屋頂上的天線，讓電視畫面更清楚。
column5: 安天納：裝在屋頂，納入天上訊號的天線

column2: The vaccine helps the body make antibodies against the virus.
column3: 疫苗幫助身體製造對抗病毒的抗體。
column5: anti 對抗 + body 身體 → 身體自己做的對抗兵

column2: In this exercise, "hot" is the antonym of "cold."
column3: 在這個練習中，「hot」是「cold」的反義字。
column4: antonym of happy (快樂的反義字)
column5: anti 相反 + nym 名字 → 意思相反的字，對照 synonym

column2: She showed a natural aptitude for music even as a small child.
column3: 她從小就展現出對音樂的天賦。
column5: apt 適合 + itude：天生適合做某事的資質

column2: The main artery carries blood from the heart to the rest of the body.
column3: 主動脈把血液從心臟送到身體其他部位。
column5: 動脈把血送出心臟，像城市的主幹道

column2: The attainment of her goal took years of patient study.
column3: 要達成她的目標，需要多年耐心的研讀。
column5: attain 達到 + ment → 達成、成就

column2: Aviation changed the world by making long trips possible in a few hours.
column3: 航空讓長途旅行幾小時就能完成，改變了世界。
column5: avi 鳥 + ation：像鳥一樣飛 → 航空

column2: We watched the birds through binoculars from behind a tree.
column3: 我們躲在樹後，用雙筒望遠鏡觀察鳥兒。
column4: pair of binoculars (一副雙筒望遠鏡)
column5: bi 兩 + ocular 眼睛 → 兩眼一起用的望遠鏡

column2: Studying biochemistry helps scientists understand how cells use food for energy.
column3: 研讀生物化學能幫助科學家了解細胞如何利用食物產生能量。
column5: bio 生命 + chemistry 化學 → 生物化學

column2: In the old story, the hero freed his people from bondage.
column3: 在古老的故事裡，英雄讓他的族人脫離了奴役。
column5: bond 綁住 + age：被繩子綁住不得自由

column2: She stayed home from school after a bad bout of the flu.
column3: 她得了一場嚴重的流感，在家休息沒去上學。
column5: bout 像「爆」：病突然爆發一陣，或拳賽打一回合

column2: Scientists announced a breakthrough in cancer treatment this week.
column3: 科學家本週宣布癌症治療有了突破性進展。
column5: break 打破 + through 穿過 → 衝破難關

column2: Their breakup surprised everyone, since they had been together for years.
column3: 他們已交往多年，分手讓所有人都很意外。
column5: break 斷開 + up：關係整個斷掉 → 分手、解體

column2: The little frog sat on the brink of the pond and watched the ducks.
column3: 小青蛙坐在池塘邊緣看著鴨子。
column5: b + rink：溜冰場 rink 的邊邊就是 brink
